description_html:
Key Features

  • Convergence-Monitored Office Suite: Advanced monitoring ensures optimal safety and operational oversight during all sessions.
  • Depth Location: Situated 102 metres below grade, providing a secure, controlled underground environment ideal for specialized business needs.
  • Spacious Floor Area: Offers 167 square metres of flexible workspace, accommodating up to 53 occupants comfortably.
  • Extended Session Length: Designed for long-duration use, supporting sessions up to 10 hours to suit intensive projects or extended meetings.
  • Secure Access Route: Accessed via a dedicated hoist cage, ensuring reliable and safe entry and exit for all users.
  • Flexible Session Fee: Pricing is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored cost solutions based on individual requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Safety and Oversight: Real-time convergence monitoring addresses user concerns about underground stability and staff safety.
  • Ample Capacity: Large floor area and high occupancy make this suite ideal for team operations, collaborative work, or events requiring significant space.
  • Productivity Support: Extended session duration enables uninterrupted workflow, suitable for training, workshops, or long meetings.
  • Secure and Controlled Access: Hoist cage entry provides peace of mind for users prioritizing safety and restricted access in underground facilities.
  • Customizable Pricing: Session fees set post-acceptance allow businesses to negotiate terms that fit their budget and usage patterns.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Corporate Meetings and Training: Perfect for organizations seeking a secure, private space for extended sessions, such as board meetings, staff training, or strategic planning.
  • Project Collaboration: Supports teams working on confidential or intensive projects that require a distraction-free, controlled environment.
  • Specialized Operations: Suitable for industries requiring underground facilities, such as mining, research, or data protection, where depth and safety monitoring are essential.
  • Flexible Event Hosting: Accommodates seminars, workshops, or conferences needing a unique and secure venue with ample space and long session times.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is the space safe and monitored? Yes, real-time convergence monitoring and secure hoist access ensure a high standard of safety and oversight.
  • What is the capacity and duration? The suite supports up to 53 people for sessions lasting up to 10 hours.
  • How is access managed? Entry and exit are controlled via a dedicated hoist cage for maximum security.
  • Is the pricing flexible? Session fees are set after acceptance, allowing for personalized arrangements based on specific usage.
